name: india-day-trader-skill
description: The Day Trader skill pack, ported to NSE and BSE

plugins.name: india-day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading NSE and BSE stocks: a chart scanner, a corporate-announcements monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager with circuit limits, a budget manager that counts Indian charges, a Zerodha order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, a quarterly-results analyst and an insider and bulk-deal tracker.
